Weekend Surprise

Saturday reveals.
Sunday happens.

One small local plan each week for people who want to cross paths naturally. No formal date or crowded calendar—just one good reason to leave the house.

Inside Weekend Surprise ↓

Inside this chapter

One plan. A little mystery.
A real Sunday.

Every gathering is small, local, and built around something easy to share. You choose whether the idea, setting, and people feel right for your weekend.

01

Saturday

A surprise appears

Every Saturday, one small local gathering is revealed in each live city—a simple plan designed to make leaving the house feel worthwhile.

02

Your choice

Raise your hand

See the idea, the partner place, and why the gathering may suit you. Request a place only when the plan genuinely feels right.

03

Sunday

The plan becomes real

Meet at a familiar public venue with a small group of people who independently chose the same way to spend their Sunday.

04

The standard

Public, small, and never forced

A visible host, clear expectations, trusted venues, and the freedom to arrive and leave on your own terms.
